final: WITH f AS (SELECT account_id, type, amount, balance FROM trans WHERE amount >= 2400), s AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -amount END) AS signed_avg FROM f GROUP BY account_id), b AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(balance) AS bal_avg FROM f GROUP BY account_id) SELECT AVG(s.signed_avg) AS avg_signed_amount, AVG(b.bal_avg) AS avg_balance FROM b LEFT JOIN s ON s.account_id = b.account_id
